name: mcp-pack
description: Bundle of MCP servers that follow you across every repo and superset worktree. Infra: Mapbox docs + DevKit, Proxyman. Static assets: Recraft (vector SVG), Iconify (icon search), Unsplash (stock photo), Playwright (visual review). Neon and Grafana moved to claude.ai connectors; Higgsfield and Nano-Banana removed 2026-08-27 — they need HF_API_KEY/HF_SECRET that were never set, so every session started with two failing servers. Re-add via the higgsfield-cli skill when needed. Enable at user scope so all sessions get them.
